description: Return the closed list of eight library categories and nothing else. Output is { categories: [{ id, label, featured, count, json_url, markdown_url, html_url }] }. id is the category id, for example bitcoin-lightning. label is the display name. featured is true only for Bitcoin and Lightning, which is first. count is how many library sources are in that category. json_url, markdown_url, and html_url are absolute links to that category JSON, Markdown, and HTML. There is no source array and no top-level count. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. The list is unpaged and always the full set; there is no limit or offset. Use list_categories instead of search_sources when you need category ids, labels, or counts. Use search_sources instead when you need the source cards in a category (pass category, for example bitcoin-lightning; limit 1-50, no offset). Use get_source instead when you already have a source id. A failed read of the library file returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Category list failed. when the failure is not an Error. Free, no auth.
name: list_categories
title: List library categories
